name: Agentics Day: MCP + Agents Europe 2027
description: CNCF co-located day on Model Context Protocol and AI agents at KubeCon
note: on-site, English; co-located with KubeCon Europe (15-18 Mar); covered by the All-Access in-person KubeCon pass; CFP closed (was until 18 Oct 2026)
details:
CNCF-hosted co-located event on the day before KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2027 in Barcelona, on the Model Context Protocol and agentic AI in cloud-native systems. The format started at KubeCon Europe 2026 in Amsterdam as a half-day with more than ten talks.

Access is via the All-Access in-person KubeCon + CloudNativeCon pass, which covers all CNCF-hosted co-located events; 2027 prices are not shown on the page. The CFP has closed. Several other co-located days run on 15 March (Platform Engineering Day, Cloud Native AI + Inference Day, Observability Day, Open Source SecurityCon).
